local-browser-smoke.instructions: Run pnpm dev and manually inspect affected public routes. A local login form or account placeholder is not WorkOS, API, staging, or production evidence; do not use customer data or production credentials locally.

workos-auth-staging.instructions: Use the protected staging Vercel deployment with the separate WorkOS test environment. Exercise Magic Auth request, invalid/expired code, rate limit, sign-out, and verified-email behavior without logging an email or code. Then exercise each explicitly allowlisted social provider: Google, and staging-only Apple if WorkOS default credentials are enabled. Verify cancellation, invalid callback state, same-WorkOS-subject idempotency, verified-email behavior, and the server-rendered header before and after sign-in/sign-out. Passwords, hosted AuthKit UI, passkeys, and Apple production configuration are intentionally out of scope.

website-api-account-session-staging.instructions: In protected staging, confirm the server-side authenticated website call to GET /v1/customer/session yields linked, unlinked, and unavailable account presentation as applicable. The browser must not select a customer or call the Worker directly; record no customer data.

api-owned-commerce-email-staging.instructions: Lemon Squeezy Test Mode webhooks, commerce projection, entitlement/licensing changes, Resend delivery, and webhook retries are owned and validated in sonder-api using its staging runbooks. This repository must not treat website fixtures, a checkout return, or a local build as evidence for those paths.

production-release-validation.instructions: Production deployment, live purchases, production email, production webhooks, D1 migrations, and irreversible operations require explicit authorization and the applicable product-platform production gates. Do not perform them during ordinary website development.
